title: Machine-learning vs. logistic regression for preoperative prediction of medical morbidity after fast-track hip and knee arthroplasty-a comparative study
summary: The comparative study trained machine-learning models on fast-track arthroplasty records and evaluated prediction of postoperative medical morbidity against logistic regression; this is a specific retrospective clinical prediction result.
